name: clamp-number
goal: Implement solver.py solve(value). value is [x, low, high], integers with low <= high. Return x clamped to the inclusive interval. Use Python standard library only.

name: balanced-brackets
goal: Implement solver.py solve(value) for a string. Return a boolean: parentheses (), square brackets [] and braces {} must be balanced and correctly nested. Ignore all other characters. Empty text is balanced. Use Python standard library only.

name: run-length-encoding
goal: Implement solver.py solve(value) for a string. Return consecutive run-length encoding as a list of [character, count] lists. Preserve character case, Unicode characters and run order. Empty string returns []. Use Python standard library only.

name: merge-intervals
goal: Implement solver.py solve(value). value is an unsorted list of integer [start,end] closed intervals with start <= end. Return sorted merged intervals as lists; merge overlaps and touching endpoints. Empty input returns []. Use Python standard library only.

name: stable-unique
goal: Implement solver.py solve(value) for a list of integers. Return each distinct integer exactly once in first-occurrence order, without sorting. Empty input returns []. Use Python standard library only.

name: matrix-transpose
goal: Implement solver.py solve(value) for a rectangular list of integer rows. Return its transpose as a list of lists. A matrix with zero rows or zero columns returns []. Use Python standard library only.

name: rotate-list
goal: Implement solver.py solve(value). value is an object with integer list items and integer k. Return items rotated right by k positions; negative k rotates left. Reduce large rotations modulo length. Empty list returns []. Use Python standard library only.

name: flatten-integers
goal: Implement solver.py solve(value). value is a list containing integers or further lists, with finite nesting. Return all integers in left-to-right depth-first order as one flat list. Empty nested lists contribute nothing. Use Python standard library only.

name: word-histogram
goal: Implement solver.py solve(value) for a string. A word is a maximal run of ASCII letters A-Z or a-z; all other characters, including digits, are separators. Count words case-insensitively and return an object mapping lowercase words to integer counts. Empty input returns {}. Use Python standard library only.

name: shortest-directed-route
goal: Implement solver.py solve(value). value has edges (directed [from,to] pairs of string labels), start and goal. Return a minimum-edge route as a list including both endpoints, or [] if unreachable. For equal-length routes choose the lexicographically smallest full route. start == goal returns [start], even with no edges. Repeated edges and cycles are allowed. Use Python standard library only.
